title: Sign On — Supervisor unlocks a PIN-locked HHD
preface: This test is to confirm a Supervisor can unlock a PIN-locked HHD by presenting their smartcard and PIN.
preconds:
**GIVEN** the HHD is PIN-locked after too many failed sign-on attempts
**AND** the seeded Supervisor smartcard and PIN are available
**AND** worked example: unlocking a PIN-locked HHD at Yorkgate (NIR)

steps.content: **WHEN** the supervisor presents their smartcard and enters their PIN
steps.expected:
**THEN** the device PIN lock is released
**AND** the HHD returns to normal sign-on

expected:
A Supervisor unlocks a PIN-locked HHD by presenting their smartcard and PIN.

[Automatable: Yes · Cross-check: CloudFare]
change_note: MOST SIGNIFICANT FINDING: the case asserted the OPPOSITE of the documented behaviour. REQ-0099.1 (TFTS Requirements Matrix, current signed-off revision) states: 'The device will allow the Translink Supervisor to unlock the device in the event that it is locked due to too many incorrect sign-on attempts... The Translink Supervisor shall present their supervisor smartcard to unlock the device... the supervisor pin is required to unlock the device.' The old case said sign-on is refused and the device stays locked — that is not what the requirement (or its predecessor REQ-1555.0, archived/superseded by REQ-0099.1, which says the same thing) describes. Old ref FBD-100383 (hierarchy doc) supported neither version. Rewritten to match the confirmed requirement.

Old ref FBD-100373 is the Refund-on-POS spec — unrelated to waybill viewing. REQ-0350.0/.1/.2 explicitly cover Supervisor viewing/printing the last 50 historic waybills for HHD/ETM/POS; correct citation, matches the '50 most recent' claim exactly.

Old ref FBD-100320 is TID/payment-terminal management — unrelated to software-version printing. REQ-0353.1 ('Print Versions of Software, Fares and Configuration', applies to HHD/ETM/POS) is the correct citation.

Old ref FBD-100342 is the CloudFare/ABT back-office User Claims spec (web portal role claims) — it does not cover the on-device Supervisor menu. REQ-0656.0 ('Translink Engineer, Operator and Supervisor shall be able to navigate menu functions using the touch screen') is the correct device-level citation. The 'Supervisor-role functions are displayed' half of the claim is not separately itemised in the library — reasonable inference from role-gated sign-on (REQ-0050.x), not blocked.

Old ref FBD-100383 (hierarchy) doesn't cover sign-off. REQ-0098.1 (device enters idle state on End Duty, applies to HHD) covers the return-to-idle half; FBD-100358 (Activity Log/Shift Viewer) confirms 'Start/End of Shift' is a tracked, device-initiated Activity Log entry, supporting the CloudFare audit claim.
